confirm.duplicate:
Duplicate {name}?

Impact:
- Creates a new tournament with copied settings.
- Teams, matches, and logs are not copied.
confirm.publish:
Publish {name}?

Impact:
- Players can join via sign-up.
confirm.unpublish:
Unpublish {name}?

Impact:
- Players can no longer join via sign-up.
confirm.schedule:
Schedule rounds for {name} now?

Impact:
- The first round is created from the seeded teams and roster edits are locked.
confirm.announce:
Send bulk Discord announcements for {name}?

Impact:
- START/RESULT updates will be pushed for active matches.
confirm.rebuildBracket: This will delete all existing matches and results and rebuild the bracket. Continue?
confirm.generateBracket:
Generate the bracket now?

This creates the first round from the seeded teams and locks roster edits.
confirm.generateBracketOverview:
Generate bracket now?

Impact:
- This will create the initial bracket rounds for all currently seeded teams.
- Staff and player views will refresh.
confirm.regenerateBracketOverview:
Regenerate bracket now?

Impact:
- This will regenerate bracket rounds and may reshuffle pending matches.
- Staff and player views will refresh.
confirm.forceRemoveTeam:
Force-remove {name} while the bracket is live?

Impact:
- The team is pulled out of every match it is placed in (those slots go back to TBD).
- Any win recorded for this team is cleared.
- This cannot be undone from here — the team has to be re-registered with roster edits unlocked.
confirm.removeTeam:
Remove {name} from this tournament?

Impact:
- Team and roster are removed from bracket participation.
- Match slots may become TBD.

You can undo immediately from the success toast.
confirm.forfeit:
Record a forfeit for {forfeiting}?

Impact:
- {advancing} is declared the winner and advances.
- The match is marked final by forfeit.
confirm.deleteTournament:
Delete "{name}" permanently?

This removes the tournament, its teams, matches, and standings. This cannot be undone.
